Home/Services/Soft Landscaping

Soft Landscaping & Planting in the Blue Mountains

Garden beds, planting and green space designed for the Mountains climate — plants that actually survive the cold snaps and suit your block.

Soft landscaping is the living part of your garden — the beds, the plants, the lawn and the mulch. Up here that means choosing cool-climate and native species that handle frost, wind and shade.

We plan planting for year-round interest and easy upkeep, prepare the soil properly, and set everything up to establish well.

What’s included

  • Cool-climate and native plant selection
  • Soil preparation and improvement
  • Garden bed design and shaping
  • Feature planting and screening
  • Mulching to lock in moisture
  • Advice on ongoing care

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.
